conventions: sigma_i=A I+A^-1 e_i; delta=-A^2-A^-2; V=(-A^3)^(-w)<closure>; t=A^-4
finite_field_theorem: Given finitely many fields F_q of characteristics p, choose even N>=2 divisible by all p(q^4-1). For every t in each F_q^*, choose A in F_(q^4)^* with A^-4=t. The quadratic (g-A)(g+A^-3)=0 divides X^N-1 in that characteristic, so both generator Nth powers are identity. Thus beta_N is the full specialized TL identity, and V_KN(t)=1. Nevertheless V_KN(-1)=1-N^2 over Z, so K_N is a nontrivial knot.
scope: Finite-field evaluation-function equality, not coefficientwise equality or complex-root equality.
